title: dryopteris loheriana
intro: Dryopteris loheriana, commonly known as Chinese shield fern, is a species of fern that belongs to the Dryopteris genus. It is traditionally used in Chinese medicine to treat various health conditions, with reported health benefits including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Dryopteris loheriana include reducing inflammation, improving immune function, and exhibiting anti-cancer effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, terpenoids, and polysaccharides, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
